proposal.model_rationale: Read from the native 1750x1500 image and enlarged crops of bands 0-2, 6-8, 10, 12 and 13; bands 3-5, 9 and 11 were read from the native image only. The image is an Arabic letter from the Northern Region Airspace Safeguarding Office. Its only English text is the office name. It contains Table 5-1 with two zones: zone A, within 1,500 m of the eastern boundary, has a 25 m maximum height and warning lighting is required; zone B has a 40 m maximum and warning lighting is required for any part over 30 m. Three notes follow, and the letter closes with the signatory's title and an empty stamp oval. No grid was detected from pixels, so each table row is stored as band lines split left and right, with ' | ' between cells. That separator is my convention and is not printed in the image. The schema requires prepared_by, but writing it is not my job, so I left it as an empty string. The empty stamp oval in the right half of band 13 is stored as an empty English line, because an empty Arabic line failed check RD5. validate_reading reports ok with no errors. The readings a reviewer should check are listed in the uncertain fields: the thousands separator in ١٬٥٠٠, and whether the 30 'days' in note 3 are calendar or working days.
